verdict.rationale: Zero's repository ships an AGENT.md file. It is agent-oriented guidance listing commands such as `pnpm go`, `pnpm test:ai` and `pnpm eval`, but it serves coding agents working on the codebase rather than agents trying to understand or use the product. An independent check found no docs site at all: 0.email serves its SPA shell on every path, the docs subdomains don't resolve, and no llms.txt is evidenced. MCP.md is only a prose capability list. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, a hosted agent-readable product docs site, structured API/MCP schema docs for agents, and independent corroboration of agent use of these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
